ComPoM plot theme

Source: R/theme.R
theme_compom.Rd

The cowplot theme with faded major gridlines, used by all plotting functions in the package. Use it (or ggplot2::theme_set(theme_compom())) to match other figures to the package plots.

Usage

theme_compom(font_size = 11)

Arguments

font_size

Base font size.

Value

A ggplot2 theme.

Examples

ggplot2::ggplot(ex_comp, ggplot2::aes(length, count)) +
  ggplot2::geom_col() +
  theme_compom()
